description: This bar chart illustrates the number of real-user demand requests categorized by input and output token ranges within the Wildchat dataset, with the 2K range defined as [2K, 4K), 4K as [4K, 8K), 8K as [8K, 16K), and 16K as [16K, 32K). The vertical axis, labeled “Number,” is scaled linearly from 0 to 120,000, with tick marks at intervals of 20,000. The horizontal axis presents eight distinct categories, each representing a combination of token range and request type (Input or Output), with the token ranges labeled as 2K, 4K, 8K, and 16K, and the request types indicated by color and fill pattern: solid fill for Input and slash fill for Output. The bars are arranged in descending order of their values, with the tallest bar being 108,494 for the 4K-Output category (reddish-orange with diagonal slashes), followed by 78,188 for 2K-Output (yellow with diagonal slashes), 17,865 for 8K-Output (light blue with diagonal slashes), and 4,247 for 16K-Output (dark blue with diagonal slashes). The remaining bars are significantly shorter: 9,320 for 2K-Input (yellow solid), 3,784 for 4K-Input (reddish-orange solid), 1,401 for 8K-Input (light blue solid), and 832 for 16K-Input (dark blue solid). Each bar is labeled with its exact numerical value above it, and the legend at the bottom explicitly maps the color and fill pattern to each category.
